title: Guidelines for the measurement of hides and skins in the wet blue condition
clause_1_scope: 1.1 This standard prescribes guidelines for measurement of hides and skins in wet blue condition. 1,1.1 This standard does not lay down any specification of quality.
clause_3_terminology: Guidelines for the measurement of hides and skins in the wet blue condition

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
